prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Brazilian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a sleek male idol face with a straight nose, a sharp jawline, thick brows and cool intense eyes, a very faint trace of stubble, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth warm bronze skin, a soft amused smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a silver miniature anvil, a silver cube-shaped block, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop with a heavy rough copper a round bell hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten mixed-metal necklaces. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

LEFT Footwear: Extreme olive-green platform loafers with thick platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Indian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth warm brown skin with a soft glow, a gentle soft smile, cool ash-grey hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a copper small flared temple bell, a silver barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold bracelets. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large, thick, heavy and extremely strong man, far beyond any real person, built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), wide cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
